# Copilot instructions

Follow the guidance in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the root of this repository: read the svelte-components docs in `node_modules/@onsvisual/svelte-components/dist/llms.txt` (or https://onsdigital.github.io/svelte-components/llms.txt) before using a component, follow the rules there, and run `npm run verify` before finishing a change.
